text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — we need to lock a design review for the Unified Telemetry Routing work (API + SDK + Console UX). Goal: align API surface, SDK ergonomics, and Console rollout plan. I uploaded a short pre-read (sections 1-5) and a checklist. Prefer 30-45m. Proposed slots: Wed 10–11am PT, Thu 2–3pm PT, Fri 9–10am PT. Please reply with availability and any must-have attendees.

Liam Chen: Wed or Thu work for me. +1 on 45m — there are a couple of API edge cases I want to surface. Need eng-oncall present for fallback policy talk.

Sophia Alvarez: Thu is best. Can we make the pre-read highlight the Console UX flows? I want to give PM/Design a quick walkthrough before the meeting.

Oliver Grant: Adding the pre-read checklist here so folks can skim: 
- Read sections 1 (Goals) and 3 (API contract)
- Review SDK ergonomics examples in section 4
- Console screenshots + rollout steps in section 5
- Add comments to section 2 if you have data model concerns

Fenced code snippet for proposed agenda: 
```
1) 5m — Goals and success metrics (Maya)
2) 10m — API contract + open questions (Liam)
3) 10m — SDK ergonomics + examples (Oliver)
4) 10m — Console UX and rollout plan (Sophia)
5) 5-10m — Actions and owners
```

Karla Nguyen: Can’t do Wed morning. Thu 2pm PT works. Please include security for the KMS/HSM notes; they’ll need 5m.

Maya Patel: Noted — security and eng-oncall added to invite list. If Thu 2pm gets the most votes we’ll finalize. Also flagging this for Dedicated and Private deployment impact (short slide in pre-read).

devex-bot: Calendar poll created: https://calendar.redwood.internal/poll/abcd1234 — options: Wed 10am PT, Thu 2pm PT, Fri 9am PT. Voting open until EOD tomorrow.

Liam Chen: Voted Thu 2pm. Also dropping the API snippet that shows the compatibility mode we discussed: 
```json
{"route": "/telemetry/v1/emit", "compat": "legacy|v2", "batching": {"window_ms": 50}}
```

Sophia Alvarez: Voted Thu 2pm. I left comments on the Console screenshots (section 5) — see comment thread on the doc for proposed microcopy tweaks.

calendar-bot: Poll closed. Thu 2pm PT selected (majority). Event created: https://calendar.redwood.internal/event/evt-5678. Invitees: Maya Patel, Liam Chen, Sophia Alvarez, Oliver Grant, Karla Nguyen, Security, Eng-oncall, DevEx.

Maya Patel: Locked — Thu 2pm PT confirmed. Pre-read: https://redwood.internal/docs/unified-telemetry/pre-read (please complete before the meeting). Quick checklist recap: comment on sections 2 & 4 (data model + SDK examples), add any Console copy edits in section 5. I’ll post a short slide deck in the thread by EOD. :thumbsup:
